app.leftOut_other: Left out {count} accounts that can't launch

settings.title: Settings
settings.clipboardHintHello: Copying or revealing a cookie asks for Windows Hello first.
settings.olderVersions: Older versions are on the releases page too. They get no fixes or support, and may not open data saved by this one.
settings.moveText: RoALT copies its database to {path} and restarts to use it. The old database is deleted after the restart. Logs and the app's browser data stay in the old folder, so the theme and other view preferences reset.
settings.bandwidthStale: Set to {kbps} kbit/s, but Windows has restarted since: apply it again.
settings.bandwidthHint: Caps outbound (upload) traffic only, for all Roblox clients together, as a Windows QoS policy. Applying needs admin rights (Windows asks each time) and lasts until Windows restarts.
settings.shutdownHintClose: Windows' own shutdown timer. When it runs out, Windows closes every app without asking, so unsaved work elsewhere is lost. RoALT's clients are closed 30 s before (if RoALT hasn't restarted since). Cancel it here, even after a restart of RoALT.
settings.shutdownHint: Windows' own shutdown timer. When it runs out, Windows closes every app without asking, so unsaved work elsewhere is lost. Cancel it here, even after a restart of RoALT.
settings.publicHint: Turned off, RoALT doesn't launch on a network Windows calls Public (café, hotel, school Wi-Fi), and a master-password vault locks there.
settings.publicConfirmText: Others on a public network can see which servers your clients connect to, and can try to reach this PC. With this on, RoALT launches there too. Only turn it on for a network you trust, and turn it off again after.
settings.backgroundCovers: The theme covers {n}% of the picture
settings.encryptionHintMaster: Asked at start and after auto-lock.
settings.encryptionHintDpapi: Windows DPAPI: unlocks with your Windows sign-in, no prompt.
settings.antiAfkHowHint: Only after 5 s without keyboard or mouse input: each client is brought to the front for a moment (a minimized one is restored, then minimized again), gets an F13 press (no game uses it, so the character stays put) and the window you had in front comes back. Roblox only counts a real key press in the window in front.
settings.publicNotNow: Not on a public network now.
settings.importWrongPassword: Wrong password, or the file is damaged.
settings.robloxMissing: Roblox isn't installed. Install it here or from roblox.com.
settings.openLogsHint: RoALT's own logs, for a bug report
look.themesHint: Ready-made colours to start from. Pick one, then change anything.
look.replaceText: Your own colours will be replaced. Copy them as a theme code first to keep them.
look.title: Your colours
look.hint: Click a colour to change it. Text stays readable whatever you pick.
look.part.island-inset: Open group in the navigation bar
look.shareHint: A short code with your colours, accent and corners.
look.badCode: That isn't a RoALT theme code.
look.cornersHint: How round panels, buttons and the navigation bar are.
look.motionHint: A moving GIF or WebP stops on its first frame while RoALT isn't in front, so it costs your Roblox clients nothing. Motion Off stops it too.
settings.languageHint: Windows follows the Windows display language when RoALT has it, else English.
settings.accentHint: Buttons, switches and highlights. Pick a preset or any colour.
settings.densityHint: Row height in the accounts list.
settings.discordHint: Your Discord profile shows “Playing RoALT” with the game and how many alts run. Only while Discord is open on this PC.
settings.closeToTrayHint: The window hides; running clients and auto-rejoin keep working.
settings.skipSplashHint: Opens RoALT right away, without the start-up animation. Applies from the next start.
settings.multiHint: RoALT holds Roblox's single-instance lock while it runs, so each account gets its own client. Turn it on before the first client starts.
settings.protectLoginHint: While RoALT's clients run, lock Roblox's shared sign-in files so clients can't overwrite each other's session (error 773, wrong account in game). Meanwhile Roblox's own app can't save its sign-in.
settings.launchDelayHint: Wait between two launches when several accounts launch at once. About a second either way is added.
settings.minimizeHint: Each client is minimized once, when it first reaches a game, without taking the focus; full-quality accounts stay visible. Home shows its last picture.
settings.autoRejoinHint: Relaunch a client Roblox disconnects (kicked, server shut down, connection lost) into the same target.
settings.autoRestartHint: Relaunch a client that closes without RoALT closing it, or whose window stops responding for 30 s. Closing Roblox's window yourself looks the same, so close clients from RoALT.
settings.antiAfkHint: So Roblox doesn't disconnect idle clients after 20 minutes, each client in a game gets a key press. Only while Windows is unlocked: a locked PC can't press keys, and RoALT says so on Discord. While it has clients, Windows doesn't go to sleep on its own. A client can opt out under its limits on Home.
settings.antiAfkEveryHint: Roblox disconnects after 20 idle minutes, so 1 to 19.
settings.breakerHint: Rejoins and restarts of one account within this time. Each waits twice as long as the one before (at most a minute); past the limit RoALT leaves it and tells you.
settings.closeGraceHint: How long a client RoALT closes gets to close by itself before it is ended.
settings.launchArgsHint: Extra words for every client, after its launch link (for a bootstrapper, say). No quotes or & | < > ^. An account can have its own in its details.
settings.fpsCapHint: The frame rate each client RoALT starts is capped at, unless the account has its own. RoALT sets Roblox's own Maximum Frame Rate just before the client starts and puts yours back once the client has read it; a batch does so for each launch. Off leaves Roblox alone.
settings.lowGraphicsHint: Clients RoALT starts use Roblox's lowest graphics quality, which saves a lot of GPU and CPU with many clients. Your own Roblox graphics setting is put back right after, and again when such a client closes (or, if RoALT isn't running then, when it next starts).
settings.askBrowserLinks: Pick the account for browser Play links
settings.askBrowserLinksHint: While RoALT is the default Roblox launcher, Play on roblox.com fills in Play here so you pick the account. Off: the game starts at once as the browser's account, which RoALT can't follow.
settings.autoUpdateHint: When Roblox has a new version and no Roblox client runs (nor a launch or batch), install it. The installer is checked to be signed by Roblox Corporation first. Never over a bootstrapper such as Bloxstrap, which updates Roblox itself.
settings.memRestartHint: Close and relaunch a client whose commit size stays over this for 30 s, into the same game, within the restart limit in Settings, Launching. Not during a batch. It disconnects the client, but it's the only way to free its private memory.
settings.memThrottleHint: While a client's commit size is over this, hold it to the CPU limit below, which lowers its frame rate. Lifted once it is back under 90 %. Tightens a client's own limit, never loosens it.
settings.trimHint: Ask Windows to page each client's memory out on a schedule, and sooner if it grows; it comes back as used. A client's own limit on Home wins.
settings.spreadHint: Give each client its own share of the cores, round-robin. Cores picked for a client on Home win. Skipped when there are too few cores for two per client.
settings.adaptiveHint: Clients whose window isn't in front get the limits below; the one you're playing runs free. A limit set on one client wins over these.
settings.adaptiveBgHint: CPU limit (a share of all cores), efficiency mode and how often to trim memory, for clients not in front.
settings.fairCapHint: Divides the CPU among the clients, so each gets a smaller cap as more run. The client in front, clients loading or not responding and Full quality accounts run free. A client's own limit on Home wins.
settings.panicHint: Works from any app, even a game in front: stops every Roblox client at once, like the Hold to stop all button. Modifiers and one key, like Ctrl+Shift+F12. Empty turns it off.
settings.cleanLogsHint: Delete Roblox's client logs over a day old or over 50 MB, at start and every hour. A running client's log is kept.
settings.masterPasswordHint: Changing it only re-wraps the key; cookies are not re-encrypted.
settings.autoLockHint: Locks the vault and wipes the key from memory (mouse movement counts as activity). Stays open while you sign in, or while clients run with auto-rejoin, auto-restart, memory/timed restarts, anti-AFK or Discord alerts.
settings.lockOnSessionLock: Lock when Windows locks or sleeps
settings.lockOnSessionLockHint: Win+L, the lock screen or sleep locks the vault too. Not while clients run that auto-rejoin, auto-restart or anti-AFK look after: they need it open.
settings.clipboard: Clear clipboard after copying a cookie
settings.cacheHint: How long the info panel reuses what Roblox said before asking again. Presence refreshes every minute while Accounts is open.
settings.backupHint: One password-protected .roalt file with every account, its cookie and its groups.
settings.aboutHint: RoALT talks to roblox.com; to GitHub for its own updates and for News; to the Roblox DevForum and Roblox's newsroom for News; to roalt.dev for the sponsor and, on this page, the supporters' names; to its online counter; to Rolimons with Rolimons values on; and to Discord once you set a webhook. All but Roblox and this page's supporters can be turned off here or in Discord. It changes nothing on your PC unless you apply a bandwidth limit. New versions are on GitHub Releases.
settings.setMasterText: RoALT will ask for it at start and after auto-lock.
settings.changeMasterText: Enter the current password, then the new one.
settings.removeMasterText: Cookies will be protected by your Windows account instead and open without a prompt.
settings.removeMasterDone: Master password removed. The vault now opens with Windows.
settings.exportText: The file holds every cookie, encrypted with this password. You need it to import the file.
settings.moveDialog: Choose a folder for RoALT's data
settings.importSettings: Also restore settings and the Discord webhook
settings.importSettingsHint: Replaces this PC's settings. Leave it off for a backup someone else gave you.
settings.importSettingsFailed: The settings were not restored. The accounts were.
settings.selfUpdateHint: Asks GitHub Releases at start and every 6 hours. A new version is offered, never installed without your click, and its installer runs only if it carries RoALT's release signature.
settings.onlineCount: Show how many people use RoALT
settings.onlineCountHint: Every few minutes, sends RoALT's counter a random ID made when RoALT starts and how many Roblox clients RoALT is running, and nothing else. The counts show beside the Discord button. Off: nothing is sent.
settings.newsHint: Home's News tab: RoALT's releases from GitHub, the Roblox DevForum's announcements and Roblox's newsroom, asked when RoALT starts and every 30 minutes while it's open. Nothing about you is sent. Off: none of them is asked, and the tab stays empty.
settings.clientInstallHint: Downloads Roblox's installer from setup.rbxcdn.com and runs it once it is verified as signed by Roblox Corporation
settings.defaultLauncherHint: Opens roblox:// and roblox-player: links, and RoALT launches your accounts through it
settings.defaultLauncherMore: With RoALT, Play on roblox.com starts the game through RoALT, and Roblox links fill in Play so you pick the account. Through a bootstrapper, RoALT's graphics flags and Modpacks are skipped: it applies its own
settings.backgroundHint: Your own picture behind the app (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 16 MB). It is kept in RoALT's data.
settings.backgroundDim: How much the theme covers the picture
settings.publicBannerBlocked: Public network: launching is off until you join a private network.
settings.updateConfirmText_one: RoALT closes while it updates and starts again by itself. {count} Roblox client keeps running, and the restarted RoALT follows it again. Its CPU limits are lifted for the few seconds RoALT is closed.
settings.updateConfirmText_other: RoALT closes while it updates and starts again by itself. {count} Roblox clients keep running, and the restarted RoALT follows them again. Their CPU limits are lifted for the few seconds RoALT is closed.

vault.prompt_other: Enter your master password to reach your {count} accounts.

accounts.add.title: Add account
accounts.add.loginPrivate: The window uses a browser profile of its own, and the sign-in is deleted from it afterwards. Close it to cancel.
accounts.add.waiting: Waiting for you to finish signing in…
accounts.add.manyLabel: Cookies or username:password, one per line
accounts.add.manyHelp: Each .ROBLOSECURITY cookie is checked with Roblox one by one; <mono>user:pass:cookie</mono> lines keep only the cookie. <mono>username:password</mono> lines open Roblox's sign-in for each account, filled in: solve any check and press Log In. Passwords only fill in the form and are never saved.
accounts.add.ramHint: Its AccountData.json; one locked with a RAM password can't be read
accounts.add.cookieHelp: The raw value or <mono>.ROBLOSECURITY=…</mono> both work. RoALT checks it with Roblox, then keeps it encrypted on this PC. Anyone with this cookie can sign in as you; never paste it anywhere else.

accounts.detail.cookieCopied_other: Cookie copied. The clipboard clears in {count} s.

accounts.detail.fpsCapHint: Set when its client starts, 5 to 360. 0 uses the default from Performance.

accounts.detail.cookieHides_other: Hides in {count} s. Never share it: it signs in as this account.

accounts.cantLaunch_other: {count} accounts can't launch and will be left out

accounts.removeManyText_one: These accounts and their saved cookies are deleted from this PC. The Roblox accounts themselves are not touched.
accounts.removeManyText_other: These accounts and their saved cookies are deleted from this PC. The Roblox accounts themselves are not touched.
accounts.emptyText: Sign in through Roblox's own page or paste a .ROBLOSECURITY cookie. Cookies are encrypted and stay on this PC.
launch.join.nobody: No friends online, and no other account with a valid cookie.
launch.join.footer: Someone in a game whose server Roblox shows joins that server; anyone else is followed when you launch.

launch.batch.pickRest_one: Pick the account that didn't launch
launch.batch.pickRest_other: Pick the {count} accounts that didn't launch

launch.fav.deleteText: {name} and its saved link are deleted.

launch.fav.picksFirst: Picking the favourite selects these accounts.
launch.err.cookieInvalid: Sign in to this account again.
launch.err.challenge: Roblox wants a human check — open the account on roblox.com.
launch.err.notFound: That account or game no longer exists.
launch.needMulti: Turn on multi-instance to launch several accounts.
launch.enterPlaceId: Enter the place ID for this job ID.
launch.targetLabel: Game link, private server, place ID or @username
launch.placeIdPlaceholder: The game's place ID or link
launch.noAccounts: No accounts yet. Add one first.
launch.onlyValid: Only an account with a valid cookie can launch
launch.fpsHint: Replaces each account's own cap and the default.
play.spreadHint: Every account joins its own server.
launch.robloxOutdated: Roblox is out of date: its update can close the other clients. Update it in Settings first.
launch.limits.oneCore: Leave at least one CPU core.
launch.limits.help: The limit is a share of all CPU cores; its frame rate drops with it. For a fixed frame rate, use the FPS cap when launching. Efficiency mode lowers its priority, as Task Manager does. Trimming asks Windows to page its memory out; it comes back as used. Limits set here win over the adaptive manager's. Anti-AFK briefly brings this client to the front for an F13 press while you're away (a minimized one is restored, then minimized again); it needs Windows unlocked.
launch.crash.mem: Restarted: commit size over the limit
launch.running.title: Running clients
launch.running.throttled: Throttled: commit size is over the limit.
launch.running.relaunchHint: Launch this account into the same game again
launch.running.closeAllText_one: {count} Roblox client RoALT started will close. Unsaved progress in those games is lost.
launch.running.closeAllText_other: {count} Roblox clients RoALT started will close. Unsaved progress in those games is lost.
launch.kill.hint: Hold for a second: ends every Roblox client at once, without saving
launch.multi.turnOnText: Roblox says it doesn't officially support running several clients at once. RoALT only holds the name Roblox's client checks when it starts and never touches the client itself, which Roblox says its enforcement against modified clients doesn't cover. Roblox has broken multi-instance before and may again.
launch.multi.closeText_one: Every running Roblox client closes ({count} process), including ones RoALT didn't start. Unsaved progress in those games is lost.
launch.multi.closeText_other: Every running Roblox client closes ({count} processes), including ones RoALT didn't start. Unsaved progress in those games is lost.
launch.multi.takeOverTitle: Take over from the running Roblox?
launch.multi.takeOverText_one: RoALT closes Roblox's own "already running" marker inside the running client ({count} process) with a standard Windows call, so new clients can start next to it without closing it. Nothing in the client's memory is changed, but this reaches into a running Roblox: if a client misbehaves afterwards, close Roblox instead. Roblox's anti-cheat may see the access.
launch.multi.takeOverText_other: RoALT closes Roblox's own "already running" marker inside the running clients ({count} processes) with a standard Windows call, so new clients can start next to it without closing it. Nothing in the client's memory is changed, but this reaches into a running Roblox: if a client misbehaves afterwards, close Roblox instead. Roblox's anti-cheat may see the access.

servers.needAccountSort: Pick an account: Roblox sorts this way only for a signed-in account.
servers.noJoin: Roblox doesn't let {name} join servers of this game.
servers.accessCheckedFor: Access was checked for {name} only; accounts without access can't join.
servers.outdated: Roblox is out of date: its update can close the other clients. Update it in Settings first.

servers.noGame: No game has that place ID.
servers.pickAccountPrivate: Pick an account: Roblox lists the private servers that account can see.
servers.noRoom: No servers with room right now.
servers.noValidAccount: No account with a valid cookie.
servers.samePcNote: Roblox's order, the same for every account on this PC: they share one IP.
servers.pingTip: Roblox's own figure for this server, not measured by RoALT.
servers.asHint: Roblox lists the servers and checks access as this account.
dashboard.throttledHint: Commit size is over the limit: held to the throttle's CPU limit
dashboard.resizeHint: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.
dashboard.tabs.label: Accounts on Home
dashboard.tabs.notSaved: Kept until RoALT closes: a private server's code is never saved.
dashboard.launchFpsCap: This launch's FPS cap, set when its client started
dashboard.accountFpsCap: This account's FPS cap, set when its client starts
dashboard.cardLabel: {name}'s client, {state}. Enter brings it to the front; the context menu key opens its actions.
dashboard.pictureAgeHint: No new picture from this client for a while: it isn't drawing, or capturing it has stalled. The client itself may be fine.
dashboard.microKept: Roblox kept this window at {w} × {h}; that is as small as it goes.
dashboard.heldHint: RoALT leaves it alone until it closes: no auto-rejoin, restarts, anti-AFK, limits or window layout. Untick Take control to hand it back.
dashboard.laidOut_one: Laid out {count} client. Hidden and minimized ones (Restore all first to include them) and ones without a window yet were left as they are.
dashboard.laidOut_other: Laid out {count} clients. Hidden and minimized ones (Restore all first to include them) and ones without a window yet were left as they are.
dashboard.tileHint: Lay every client out on this monitor so all fit
discord.evLaunchHint: A client got into a game (not after a rejoin, restart or reconnect).
discord.evCrashHint: A client closed without RoALT closing it.
discord.evHangHint: A client's window hasn't responded for 30 s.
discord.evDisconnectHint: Roblox kicked a client, its server shut down or the connection was lost. Also when Windows is locked while anti-AFK looks after clients: it can't press keys then.
discord.evSignInHint: An account's saved sign-in stopped working, or Roblox refused a client's sign-in or wants a human check.
discord.evRestartHint: Auto-rejoin or auto-restart launched an account again.
discord.evMemRestartHint: A client was restarted because it used too much memory.
discord.evBreakerHint: RoALT stopped relaunching an account after too many tries.
discord.evBatchDoneHint: How many accounts of a batch made it into the game.
discord.evThrottleHint: A client was slowed down because it uses too much memory.
discord.evUpdateHint: A newer RoALT is out. Said once per version.
discord.saved: Webhook saved. Send a test to check it.
discord.removed: Webhook removed. RoALT sends nothing to Discord now.
discord.intro: Get told in a Discord channel when a client crashes, gets disconnected or is relaunched. RoALT posts to a webhook you create in the channel's settings (Integrations, Webhooks). Discord is the only place besides Roblox RoALT sends anything to, and only once a webhook is set. Messages name accounts by display name and username; never a cookie, link or log.
discord.pingHint: Your Discord user ID, or a role as <@&id>. Choose which alerts mention it below.
discord.pingLevelHint: Urgent pings only for crashes, gave-up accounts and blocked anti-AFK. Warnings also pings for disconnects, hangs and sign-in trouble.
discord.setLocked: Set, but the vault is locked. Unlock it to see or change the webhook.
discord.setId: Set (id {id}). The URL is encrypted in the vault; messages go out only while it is unlocked.
discord.notSet: Not set. Paste the webhook URL Discord shows (Copy Webhook URL).
discord.statusSummaryHint: How many clients run, with their RAM and CPU.
discord.lead: Your Discord status, and alerts in a channel.
monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.empty: Clients you launch show here while they run.
monitor.memoryHint: Task Manager's Memory column (private working set); commit size in the tooltip
monitor.restartsHint: Rejoins and restarts that led to this client
home.welcomeLead: Run your Roblox accounts side by side. Three steps to your first game.
home.idleLead: Choose a game and press Play. Your accounts are ready.
home.step1Text: Sign in through Roblox's own page. Your sign-in is encrypted and stays on this PC.
home.step2Text: Use Browse games to pick a game, or paste a Roblox game link, private server or @username.
home.step3Text: RoALT starts Roblox, joins the game and keeps watch. Dropped clients can rejoin by themselves.
home.gettingIn: Getting your accounts into the game
home.autoRejoinOn: Auto-rejoin is on, so dropped clients come back.
home.acct.label: This account
home.acct.notRunning: Live numbers show here while its client runs.
donate.title: Support RoALT
donate.text: Pick an amount. It opens that gamepass on Roblox in your browser, and you confirm the purchase there. RoALT doesn't buy anything itself.
groups.defaults.title: Defaults of {name}
groups.defaults.lead: What this group's accounts use where they set nothing of their own. An account in several groups takes each from the first group in the list that sets it.
accounts.detail.fromGroups: From its groups, where nothing is set here: {list}.
launch.fav.groupsHint: Everyone in these groups launches with it, as the groups are at that moment.
crashes.lead: How your clients ended: crashes, disconnects, freezes and the restarts RoALT made. The newest 200 are kept on this PC.
crashes.emptyText: A client that crashes, is disconnected or freezes shows up here.
crashes.verdict.crashed: The client itself crashed: Roblox or Windows recorded the fault.
crashes.verdict.noLog: It ended before writing a log. Look at your antivirus, the Roblox install or the client's version.
crashes.verdict.early: It closed within 30 seconds with no crash recorded: something closed it, or it closed itself.
crashes.verdict.unknown: No crash was recorded: it was closed by hand, by another program or by itself.
history.needsSignIn: Sign this account in again to see its Robux.
history.noEnds: No crash, disconnect or freeze recorded.
accounts.bulk.title: Edit the selected accounts
settings.globalKeyHint: A key combination that works in any app, like Ctrl+Alt+R. Empty: none.
accounts.detail.clientLimitsHint: Set on one of its running clients. Its next client starts with them.
launch.limits.kept: RoALT keeps these for this account's next client.
settings.restartEveryShort: Closes and relaunches each client after this long in a game. Long runs use more and more memory.
settings.restartEveryHint: Never the clients of Full quality accounts or the one in front. It returns to the same game. Accounts with Bring it back if it drops off are left alone.
settings.closeAfterShort: Closes each client once its run has lasted this long, and doesn't launch it again. A rejoin or restart goes on with the same run.
settings.signInWatchShort: Checks every account's sign-in in the background, so a dead one is known before a launch finds it.
settings.signInWatchHint: RoALT asks Roblox about each saved sign-in 90 seconds after it starts and every 6 hours, one account at a time. One that stopped working is marked, and told to Discord if a webhook is set. Off: sign-ins are checked only when you ask.
discord.evPcHint: With clients running: memory at 90% or more for a minute, or the clients' GPU use at 95% or more for five.
settings.showSponsorHint: One card in News names who sponsors RoALT. Sponsors help pay for it. To show it, RoALT asks roalt.dev who the sponsor is and sends nothing about you. Off: no sponsor card. News itself has its own switch, above.
donate.perks: Monthly supporters on Buy Me a Coffee get a Supporter role on Discord and their name in RoALT's About.
home.verdictHint: How much room your whole PC has: CPU {cpu}, memory {memory}
home.retryLine: RoALT keeps trying for up to 60 minutes. Last problem: {why}
browse.picking: Picking for Play: Roblox's Play or Join button here fills in Play and starts nothing.
launch.last.title: Last played
launch.last.none: No servers yet. They show here once an account has played through RoALT.
launch.last.footer: Servers the clients RoALT followed on this PC were in. One that has closed can't be joined again.
play.staggerHint: Starting clients slowly is easier on your PC and on Roblox.
play.autoRejoinHint: If Roblox disconnects a client, RoALT brings it back into the same game.
launch.multi.needText: Roblox says it doesn't officially support running several clients at once, and has broken it before. RoALT never touches the client itself.
crashes.rawLogHint: Opens the raw Roblox log file (unredacted — may contain session data). Use Debug › Copy diagnostics to share safely.
crashes.rawCsvHint: Exports raw crash history including account names (unredacted).
accounts.add.staysHere: Your sign-ins are encrypted and stay on this PC.
accounts.add.moreWays: More ways to add (cookie, bulk, import)…
accounts.add.descLogin: A Roblox window opens. Passkeys and 2-step verification work there.
accounts.add.descCookie: If you already have the account's .ROBLOSECURITY value.
accounts.add.descMany: Paste a list, or import from Roblox Account Manager.
accounts.detail.bringBack: Bring it back if it drops
accounts.detail.bringBackHint: Auto-rejoin and auto-restart for this account.
performance.tagBalanced: A good start for most PCs.
performance.tagDefaults: RoALT leaves Roblox as it is.
performance.factFair: Background clients share the CPU, at most {n}% each
performance.factMainAccount: Mark your main account Full quality
performance.factBootstrapper: No flags under Bloxstrap and the like
performance.factNextLaunch: Graphics changes apply on the next launch
performance.shareHint: Only performance settings travel: no accounts, passwords, launch arguments or hotkeys.
performance.hintFps: The most frames per second each client draws. Lower uses less of your PC.
performance.fpsOverridden: These accounts use their own cap instead, set on each account: {names}
performance.hintLow: Saves a lot of GPU and CPU with many clients. Your own Roblox setting is put back afterwards.
performance.hintLight: Turns on the graphics flags below. Uses much less GPU memory.
performance.graphicsHint: Written to Roblox as FastFlags while each client starts. Skipped under Bloxstrap and the like, which keep their own.
performance.hintMsaa: Lower is faster, but edges look jagged.
performance.hintTexture: Lowest uses the least GPU memory.
performance.hintRenderMode: Change it only if you get artifacts or crashes. Roblox may ignore Vulkan and OpenGL.
performance.hintGraySky: Replaces the skybox with flat gray.
performance.hintLowestFrm: Forces Roblox's lowest internal quality level.
performance.hintPauseVoxelizer: Stops Roblox updating its voxel lighting, so lighting can look wrong.
performance.hintMinimize: Each client minimizes once it reaches a game, without stealing your focus. Home shows its last picture.
home.noneInGame: No accounts in a game right now
accounts.detail.bringBackOff: Auto-rejoin and auto-restart are both off in Settings, so nothing brings it back yet.
launch.multi.replaceTitle: This replaces the client that's running.
launch.multi.replaceText: Multi-instance is off, so Roblox closes the running client when another one starts. Turn it on to keep both.
home.signedOutTitle: Your accounts need signing in again
home.signedOutLead: Open Accounts and press Sign in again on each one.
vault.forgot: Forgot it? It can't be recovered. To start over, close RoALT, delete roalt.db and roalt.db.key from %LOCALAPPDATA%\RoALT, and add your accounts again.
performance.hintTinyOnLaunch: Each new client goes to the tiny size once it reaches a game. Full quality accounts keep their size.
vault.recovery.showText: It is shown only this once. If you forget your master password, it lets you set a new one. It works once, and then you get a new code.
vault.recovery.copied: Copied. The clipboard clears itself shortly.
vault.recovery.limitFile: A code file on this PC opens your vault for anyone who finds it. Keep it on a USB stick, a phone or paper.
vault.recovery.limitPc: It works only for this Windows user on this PC. After a Windows reinstall or on a new PC it won't help; a .roalt backup does.
vault.recovery.forgotText: Enter your recovery code and choose a new master password. The code then stops working and you get a new one.
vault.recovery.rowHintOn: A code is set. Replacing it stops the old one working.
vault.recovery.rowHintOff: Optional. A code lets you set a new master password if you forget this one.
vault.recovery.offerText: Optional. If you forget the master password, this code lets you set a new one. Without it, the vault can't be opened.
vault.recovery.replaceText: Enter your master password. The old code stops working straight away.
vault.recovery.createText: Enter your master password. The code is shown only once.
vault.recovery.changeReminder: Your recovery code keeps working after this. If someone else may know the old password, replace the code too.
performance.appliedRelaunch: Profile applied. Running clients get its graphics at their next launch.
monitor.commitHint: Task Manager's Commit size: what the client has reserved, and what the high-memory limits watch. A trim doesn't lower it.
dashboard.trimmedFrom: Memory column {before} → {after}. It comes back as the client needs it, and commit size stays.
home.lostMany_one: {count} client is waiting to come back.
home.lostMany_other: {count} clients are waiting to come back.
settings.tabLayoutHint: Where accounts and RoALT's sections go.
settings.soundHint: Subtle sounds for clicks, switches and notifications.
accounts.toast.befriendCaptcha: Roblox wants a captcha from {names}: open their session and try again
settings.browserDataHint: What the sign-in and session windows remember, so solved captchas stay solved. Reset it if those windows misbehave; Roblox may ask for a captcha again. Your accounts stay signed in.
settings.browserDataBusy: Close the Roblox sign-in and session windows first
accounts.detail.mainHint: Your own account: listed first, skipped by select-all, and confirmed before removing it or showing its cookie. Only one at a time.
accounts.detail.mainCookieText: @{name} is your MAIN account. Anyone with its cookie can sign in as it, so keep it to yourself.
accounts.detail.fpsCapShort: 5 to 360 FPS when its client starts
settings.protectMainHint: Select all (Ctrl+A, the header box, Launch's Select all) skips your MAIN account. You can still tick it by hand.
accounts.befriendText: {count} accounts will friend each other: {pairs} pairs. Friendships are public on Roblox, so anyone can see these accounts are linked.
accounts.exportText: Cookies to export: {count}. They go into a text file in RoALT's folder, one username:cookie per line, and Explorer opens with the file selected.
accounts.exportWarning: Anyone with this file can sign into these accounts. RoALT deletes it after 10 minutes or when RoALT closes, but antivirus or cloud sync could copy it before then.
accounts.exportPassword: Enter your master password to export these cookies.
accounts.exportSkipped: Skipped, their cookie couldn't be read: {count}
accounts.removeMainConfirm: {name} is your MAIN account. Remove it from RoALT anyway?
accounts.mainSkipped: Your MAIN account was left out. Pick it by hand to include it.
accounts.befriendRange: Make friends needs 2 to {max} signed-in accounts.
performance.hintMuteOnLaunch: Each client is muted once it reaches a game. Unmute one in the Windows volume mixer.
performance.adaptiveShort: Limits clients that aren't in front.
performance.fairCapShort: Each client's cap shrinks as more run.
performance.trimShort: Pages client memory out on a schedule.
performance.memThrottleShort: Slows a client down past this size.
performance.memRestartShort: Disconnects and relaunches a client past this size.
performance.previewFpsHint: How often each live preview is redrawn.
performance.previewFpsMore: Higher rates use more CPU, more so with many clients.
performance.bench.title: For this PC
performance.bench.intro: Watches the clients already in a game for about 25 seconds, then suggests what to turn on. Nothing new is launched.
performance.bench.needGame: Start a client and let it reach a game first.
performance.bench.measuring: Measuring… keep your clients in their games.
performance.specs.hint: Rough numbers from this PC's specs; the game changes them. Measure under For this PC for real ones.
performance.bench.underLimits: CPU was measured under your current limits, so it may read low.
performance.bench.none: Nothing to change: your settings already fit.
performance.bench.stale: Your settings changed since this measurement. Measure again for suggestions that fit them.
performance.bench.capsRefused: Windows refused CPU caps on this PC, so clients are spread across cores instead.
performance.bench.capsUnknown: CPU caps haven't been tried on this PC yet.
performance.bench.gpuRough: The GPU figure is rough: it adds up each client's busiest engine.
performance.bench.restarts: Memory restarts in the last 7 days: {n}
performance.bench.crashes: Crashes after a long run in the last 7 days: {n}
performance.bench.why.fpsCap: A cap of {fps} FPS cuts each client's CPU and GPU use.
performance.bench.why.fpsCapGpu: Your GPU peaked at {gpu}%, so the cap is a step lower: {fps} FPS.
performance.bench.why.lowGraphics: Your PC is busy with this many clients: the lowest graphics save GPU and CPU.
performance.bench.why.lowGraphicsGpu: Your GPU peaked at {gpu}%: the lowest graphics save most of that.
performance.bench.why.lighterRendering: Lighter graphics flags use much less GPU memory.
performance.bench.why.minimizeOnLaunch: With {n} clients, minimized ones save GPU while you play one.
performance.bench.why.tinyOnLaunch: Tiny {width}×{height} windows draw far fewer pixels, and hidden clients stop drawing.
performance.bench.why.muteOnLaunch: Sound from {n} clients at once is only noise.
performance.bench.why.autoSpread: Spreads {n} clients over your {cores} cores so they don't crowd the same ones.
performance.bench.why.fairCap: The CPU would be over the limit: each background client gets at most {cap}%.
performance.bench.why.adaptive: Background clients are held to {cap}% CPU, with efficiency mode.
performance.bench.why.adaptiveEco: Windows refused CPU caps here, so background clients get efficiency mode only.
performance.bench.why.trimEveryMin: Frees each client's unused memory every {min} minutes.
performance.bench.why.memThrottle: Clients peaked at {peak} MB: one past {mb} MB is slowed down before it fills your RAM.
performance.bench.why.memRestart: The clients would need more RAM than you have: one past {mb} MB is restarted. A restart disconnects it.
performance.bench.why.memRestartCrash: Long runs crashed {crashes} times this week: a client past {mb} MB is restarted first. A restart disconnects it.
performance.bench.why.previewFps: Home's previews at {fps} FPS leave more for the clients.
performance.bench.why.previewOff: Home's previews off: the clients keep the GPU time a live picture costs.
launch.layoutHint: Each client goes into its own spot on RoALT's monitor once it's in a game, in list order. Fit: as big as all fit. Tiny: tiny-size, as many as fit.
settings.multiShort: One client per account, side by side.
settings.launchArgsShort: Extra words after each launch link.
settings.autoRestartShort: Relaunches a client that crashes or hangs.
settings.antiAfkShort: Keeps idle clients from being kicked.
settings.panicShort: Stops every client, from any app.
settings.shutdownShort: Windows' own timer. It closes every app.
settings.publicShort: Off: no launching on Public networks.
settings.aboutShort: What RoALT connects to, and what it changes.
settings.encryptionMoreMaster: Cookies are sealed with AES-256-GCM, using a key made from your master password with Argon2id. Copying or revealing a cookie asks for that password first.
settings.encryptionMoreDpapi: Windows encrypts the vault for your Windows account: another PC or another Windows user can't open it, though software running as you can. Set a master password if you want RoALT to lock against software running on your account too. In Windows sign-in mode, Windows Hello confirms reveal, copy and export in the UI.
launch.layoutPreviewHint: Shows on your screen, for a few seconds, where each picked account's window will go and in what order
news.lead: What's new in RoALT and on Roblox.
news.clientText: New clients start on this version. Running ones keep theirs until they close.
news.off: News is off, so RoALT doesn't ask GitHub, the DevForum or Roblox's newsroom for it.
settings.motionHintOn: Liquid motion: pills flow, pages pour in, controls stretch. Kept on this PC.
settings.motionHintReduced: Fades and progress only; nothing travels, bounces or blurs.
settings.motionHintOff: No animation at all: everything changes at once.
flags.title: Custom FFlags
flags.hint: Your own FastFlags, written to Roblox as each client starts.
flags.more: They go over the rendering flags above, so yours win, and Roblox's file goes back as it was once the client has read it. Roblox only applies flags on its allowlist and ignores the rest. Skipped under Bloxstrap and the like, which keep their own. Per account: each account sets its own in its options.
flags.accountHint: This account's own FFlags, used while custom FFlags are set per account.
flags.note: Roblox only applies FFlags on its allowlist and ignores the rest. Not used under Bloxstrap and the like.
flags.empty: No flags yet. Add one, or paste JSON from Bloxstrap with Edit as JSON.
flags.name: Flag name
flags.badJson: That isn't valid JSON. Paste an object of flag names and values.
flags.badValue: {name} needs a text, number or true/false value.
flags.hintAccount: Each account sets its own in its options, under Accounts.
move.title: Move {name}?
move.text: {name} is already playing. RoALT closes its client and joins again here. If it's the same game, it goes to the smallest other server.
move.notice: {name} is already playing. Playing moves its client here, after asking.
accounts.add.queueHint: Solve the check in the Roblox window and press Log In. Close the window to skip this account.
browse.none: Add an account to browse Roblox as it.
settings.lockPurchasesShort: No spending Robux or buying Robux and Premium in Browse. Free items still work.
settings.lockPurchasesHint: In Browse, anything that spends Robux is refused before it reaches Roblox, and the Robux, Premium and billing pages don't open. Getting free items still works. Purchases inside a game happen in the Roblox client, which RoALT can't block.
browse.blocked.robux: Purchase blocked: Lock purchases is on (Settings, Security).
browse.blocked.money: Buying Robux or Premium is blocked: Lock purchases is on (Settings, Security).
market.off: Limiteds and their values come from Rolimons' public item list, which RoALT only downloads with Rolimons values on.
market.unreachable: Rolimons' item list couldn't be downloaded. Try again in a few minutes.
market.name: Name
browse.popularNone: Roblox sent no game lists just now. Try again in a while.
browse.playtimeHint: Time in a game from the clients RoALT launched or followed. Play outside RoALT isn't counted.
browse.playtimeNone: No playtime yet. It adds up while clients RoALT launched are in a game.
browse.blocked.signOut: Signing out isn't available in Browse: it would sign this account out of RoALT too.
browse.busy: A launch is already running. Try again when it's done.
game.listCut: Not the whole list: the game has more than RoALT reads, or Roblox stopped answering.
value.title: Limiteds
value.slow: Counting reads the account's whole inventory, a page a second.
value.noRolimons: No Rolimons values yet. Their list is downloaded when you count; after a failed download, RoALT waits 5 minutes before it tries again.
value.projectedHint: Rolimons thinks its RAP is pushed above what it's worth.
settings.rolimonsShort: Adds Rolimons' value, demand and trend to your limiteds. Contacts rolimons.com.
settings.rolimonsHint: When you count an account's limiteds or open Browse › Limiteds, RoALT downloads Rolimons' public item list from api.rolimons.com (at most every 30 minutes) and adds its value, demand, trend and flags. Only that list is fetched: no user ID, username or cookie is sent. Rolimons isn't part of Roblox, and its terms don't allow automated access without its permission. Off by default.
value.notUpdated: Roblox stopped answering partway through the inventory: the last full count is kept.
game.serversHint: An estimate: players now over the server size.
player.counting: Counting their limiteds… A big inventory takes up to a minute.
player.private: Their inventory is private: Roblox doesn't show their limiteds.
player.busy: Another count is running. Press Count when it's done.
mods.lead: Change Roblox's textures, sounds and fonts. Applies to clients RoALT starts next.
mods.intro: Modpacks change only how Roblox looks and sounds on this PC: other players see the normal game. They can't carry code. RoALT takes only images, sounds, fonts, meshes and font lists from a modpack, and never changes Roblox's own folder: it starts clients from its own copy. Clients already running keep what they loaded. Roblox may change what it allows.
mods.notApplied: Not applied to the last launch
mods.emptyText: A modpack is a zip with content, PlatformContent or ExtraContent folders, laid out as in Roblox's own folder.
mods.emptyBloxstrap: Mods made for Bloxstrap work too.
mods.order: Higher in the list wins when two modpacks change the same file.
mods.removeText: Its files are deleted from RoALT. Clients already running keep what they loaded.
mods.skipped_one: {count} file left out: modpacks can't change it.
mods.skipped_other: {count} files left out: modpacks can't change them.
mods.ack1: Modpacks from others can show misleading pictures or text, such as fake prompts.
mods.ack2: RoALT blocks code, but you're responsible for what you add.
mods.ack3: Roblox may change what it allows.
onboarding.title: Set up RoALT
onboarding.qa: QA build: this setup replays every time RoALT starts.
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to RoALT
onboarding.welcome.text: RoALT keeps all your Roblox accounts in one place and starts as many of them as you like, each in its own window. Setting it up takes about a minute.
onboarding.look.title: Language and look
onboarding.look.text: Pick what suits you. You can change it any time in Settings.
onboarding.safe.title: Keeping your accounts safe
onboarding.safe.text: Your accounts' sign-ins are stored encrypted on this PC. Choose what unlocks them.
onboarding.safe.windowsText: Opens by itself while you're signed in to Windows. Another PC, another Windows user or a copied data folder can't read your accounts; a program running as you could.
onboarding.safe.masterText: RoALT asks for it when it starts and locks itself when you step away, so even programs running as you can't open it while it's locked. Keep the recovery code it offers: forgetting both means signing in to every account again.
onboarding.safe.change: A master password is set. You can remove it in Settings › Security.
onboarding.use.title: What will you use RoALT for?
onboarding.use.text: Pick any: each turns on the settings it needs.
onboarding.use.manyText: Run more than one Roblox window at the same time.
onboarding.use.online: Keep them online while I'm away
onboarding.use.onlineText: Rejoin after a disconnect, restart after a crash, press a key now and then so Roblox doesn't kick idle accounts, and keep RoALT in the tray when you close the window.
onboarding.use.more: Everything else is in Settings › Goals.
onboarding.account.title: Add your first account
onboarding.account.text: You sign in on Roblox's own page, in a window RoALT opens. Passkeys and 2-step verification work, and RoALT never saves your password.
onboarding.account.have_one: You have {count} account. Add another, or go on.
onboarding.account.have_other: You have {count} accounts. Add another, or go on.
onboarding.done.title: You're all set
onboarding.done.text: To play, click Browse games or paste a game link on Play, pick your accounts and press Play. Want a quick look around first?
onboarding.tour.homeText: What's running now, each client's window and its limits, and News about RoALT and Roblox.
onboarding.tour.playText: Paste a game link, a server link or someone's username, pick the accounts, then press Play.
onboarding.tour.accountsText: All your accounts: groups, notes, Robux, and each one's details. Add more here.
onboarding.tour.settingsText: Everything else. Goals lists the settings by what you want to do.
onboarding.replayHint: Go through the first-run setup and the short tour again.
settings.by.label: Group settings by
settings.goal.manySay: One Roblox client per account, side by side.
settings.goal.onlineSay: Bring a client back when it is kicked, crashes or sits idle.
settings.goal.stopSay: Close every client at once, now or on a timer.
settings.goal.robloxSay: Which Roblox RoALT starts, and what opens Play links.
settings.goal.lighter: Make it lighter on my PC
settings.goal.lighterSay: Lower the FPS, graphics, CPU and memory each client takes.
settings.goal.lookSay: Theme, colours, language, sounds and the window.
settings.goal.protectSay: Lock the saved cookies, and block what should never happen by accident.
settings.goal.data: Back up or move my data
settings.goal.dataSay: One backup file, and where RoALT keeps everything.
settings.goal.alertsSay: Discord messages when something happens. These settings are in Discord.
settings.goal.keysSay: Your own keys that work from any app, and every key RoALT answers to.
settings.goal.aboutSay: What RoALT checks online, and where to ask.
performance.sharedStay: Every client shares these, so they stay as in Settings: {list}
accounts.detail.profileHint: Its clients use this instead of the Performance settings.
discord.rpc.showGameHint: Show the name of the Roblox experience you're playing.
discord.rpc.showCountHint: Show how many Roblox accounts are currently running.
discord.rpc.showElapsedHint: Display how long your current session has been running.
discord.rpc.showButtonsHint: Show the RoALT website and Discord invite buttons on your profile.
discord.rpc.customHint: Leave blank for automatic text. Use {game} and {count} as placeholders.
launch.limits.applyAllHint: Apply these limits to every running client now (keeps each account's saved limits).
groups.defaults.clearOverrides: Also clear per-account overrides for accounts in this group so these defaults apply to them
settings.hotkeyListening: Listening for a key combination. Press Esc to cancel.
settings.headlessHint: Start Cordial clients without a game window (uses Cage). They keep running in the background; close them from RoALT.
settings.keepRunningHint: Closing a client's game window leaves it running in the background. Close it from RoALT when you are done.
performance.headlessResolutionHint: Render resolution for headless clients. Lower values use less GPU and memory; a new value applies the next time a headless client starts.
settings.mocktailText: Mocktail normally allows one client. With Multi-instance on, RoALT uses one launcher copy and isolated data per account; this is experimental and not verified with a signed-in launch. There are no live previews.
